placements.title: The analytics stack moves to whichever platform offers faster queries at lower licensing cost
placements.frame: What reason is given for moving the analytics workload between data platforms, and is that reason backed by observed results or only projected ones?
placements.why: The position carries Dave's quoted justification (10x query performance, lower licensing cost) and the memo's recorded decision, gain and Q3 2026 timeline. Future documents on analytics infrastructure choices can keep feeding this theme. The 10x figure and the date are evidence inside the position and do not become leaves of their own.
